articleTitle: Effectiveness of digital and mobile-based interventions on sleep quality among nurses: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
takeaways: Digital and mobile health interventions showed statistically significant improvements in sleep quality scores among nurses compared to control groups
Mobile apps and digital platforms targeting sleep behavior modification demonstrated measurable benefits for healthcare workers experiencing high-stress shift work
Systematic analysis confirmed that technology-based sleep interventions can effectively address work-related sleep disturbances in nursing populations
Meta-analysis results support the use of digital health tools as evidence-based solutions for sleep problems commonly experienced by shift-working nurses
